title: Photorealistic phone interior and lesson hotspots verified
summary: Replaced the default flat interior with a bundled AI-generated realistic teardown visualization and nine accessible component hotspots.

changes.detail: Photographic materials, optical camera lenses, populated circuit boards, solder joints, battery pouch, ribbon cables and machined metal from an AI-generated educational visualization.
Default view opens the realistic interior with nine numbered, localized touch/keyboard lesson targets; a separate 3D diagram remains available for rotation and exploded layers.
Offline embedded JPEG, photo-to-diagram fallback on image failure, synchronized component selection and double-tap cover replacement.
Localized note clearly identifies the AI-generated conceptual component locations rather than claiming a photograph or exact teardown of a real model.
